title: Retrieval and purification of human β cells from stem cell-derived islet engrafted mice
protocol: Weigh 20 mg of collagenase and add it to 10 mL RPMI to make the Collagenase I solution.
Prepare 5 mL of Collagenase I solution per mouse/graft.
Keep Collagenase I solution on ice at all times to protect it from degradation.
Prepare sorting buffer (0.5% BSA in PBS).
Prepare 30 mL of sorting buffer per mouse/graft.
Anesthetize mouse with 1-2% isoflurane and assess anesthetic depth by a firm toe pinch using front toes.
Place mouse on infrared heat pad for temperature regulation and apply sterile eye ointment before shaving to minimize the risk of introducing hair in the eye and drying of the eyes.
Shave and disinfect the surgical site with betadine swabs alternated with alcohol at least three times.
Make a less than 1 cm incision on the back above the kidney to allow access to the organ.
Free kidney from adhesion and fat by carefully cutting fat away from the kidney without damaging the kidney using micro dissecting scissors.
Identify the graft (filmy white graft is visible on ventral side of left kidney).
Euthanize mouse by performing cardiac puncture if blood collection is needed or by giving lethal amount of isoflurane inhalant, followed by cervical dislocation.
Trim fat as closely as possible from kidney.
Remove the kidney with the graft from the body.
Place kidney with graft in a petri dish that contains 5 mL of PBS to keep the graft hydrated.
Dissect kidney into hemispheres using a razor blade.
Gently peel graft-containing capsule using forceps.
Slice the graft into several small pieces by pulling apart using two plastic tips.
Make sure you chop the graft into small pieces (approximately 1 mm) before proceeding to the next step.
Place the graft pieces into a 50 mL tube with 5 mL of Collagenase I solution.
Keep the tube on ice until ready to proceed to the next step.
Incubate the graft in a water bath at 37°C for 45 min.
Vigorously shake or vortex the mixture every 15 min.
If after 45 min there is undissociated tissue, incubate for an additional 10 min but do not exceed total of 55 min.
Break up the tissue with a wide mouth pipette and filter the homogenized graft through a 200 μm cell strainer into a new 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the graft homogenate at 500 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 10 mL sorting buffer (0.5% BSA in PBS).
Filter the cell suspension using a 37 μm filter.
Determine the cell number using a manual or automatic cell counter.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 10 min.
Aspirate the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 80 μL of sorting buffer per 1 × 10⁷ total cells.
Add 20 μL of Mouse Cell Depletion Cocktail per 1 × 10⁷ total cells.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min at 2°C–8°C.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 5 mL of sorting buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Adjust volume to 500 μL using sorting buffer for up to 1 × 10⁷ total cells.
Keep the cells at 20°C–22°C until ready to proceed to step 25.
Place column in the magnetic field of a QuadroMACS Separator.
Prepare column by rinsing with 3 mL of sorting buffer.
Wait until it stops dripping.
Put a 15 mL tube under the column for collecting unlabeled fraction of human cells.
Apply cell suspension (500 μL) onto the column.
Collect flow-through containing unlabeled cells, representing the enriched human cells.
Wash column twice with 1 mL of sorting buffer.
Collect the unlabeled cells that pass through at the same tube.
Remove column from the separator and place it in a new 15 mL collection tube for collecting magnetic labeled fraction of mouse cells.
Pipette 3 mL of buffer onto the column.
Immediately flush out the magnetically labeled mouse cells by firmly pushing the plunger into the column.
Collect a small fraction (˜ 300 μL) of both the human and mouse final resuspension for quality control assessment and transfer each to new 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 100 μl of surface staining buffer (PBS + 2% FBS) to each tube and incubate for 30 min.
Prepare 100 μL of 2× concentrated surface staining antibody mix for each sample.
For one sample: Add the mouse lineage cocktail-PB antibody (biolegend 133310, dilution 1:50) + HLA-ABC-PE antibody (biolegend 311405, dilution 1:50) to 100 μL of surface staining buffer.
Add 100 μL of 2× concentrated surface staining antibody mix into each sample.
Incubate on ice for 45 min.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of surface staining buffer and incubate as a wash step.
Repeat previous steps once.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 100 μL of cytofix/cytoperm buffer solution to each sample.
Incubate for 15 min at 20°C–22°C.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of perm/wash buffer to each sample.
Incubate as a wash step.
Repeat previous steps once.
Prepare 200 μL of 2× concentrated intracellular staining antibody mix for each sample.
Calculate volume needed: (n + 1) × 200 = volume needed for staining.
Add Rat anti-C-Peptide antibody to surface staining buffer at dilution 1:50 for one sample preparation.
Incubate the prepared solution for 1 hour at 20°C–22°C.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of perm/wash buffer to each sample.
Prepare 200 μL of 2× concentrated secondary antibody mix for each sample.
Add Donkey anti-Rat IgG Secondary Antibody, Alexa Fluor 488 (ThermoFisher, A-21208) to the calculated volume of surface staining buffer.
Calculate the total volume needed by multiplying the number of samples plus one by 200 μL.
Add 200 μL of 2× concentrated secondary antibody mix into each sample and incubate at 20°C–22°C for 30 min.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Add 200 μL of perm/wash buffer (1×) to each sample and incubate at 20°C–22°C.
